---- MODULE etcd_raft ----
EXTENDS etcd_raftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

\* Certificates record <<voter, term, candidate>>.  Pending certificates
\* are bounded by volatile votes; transmitted certificates are also
\* bounded by persisted votes, so a crash cannot enable a second vote.
AG_MessageCerts(M) ==
  {<<m.msource, m.mterm, m.mdest>> :
    m \in {x \in M : x.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ x.mvoteGranted}}
AG_Active == {i \in Server : state[i] \in {Candidate, Leader}}
AG_Counted == {e \in Server \X Nat \X Server :
  e[3] \in AG_Active /\ e[2] = currentTerm[e[3]] /\ e[1] \in votesGranted[e[3]]}
AG_Stable == AG_MessageCerts(DOMAIN messages) \cup AG_Counted
AG_All == AG_Stable \cup AG_MessageCerts(DOMAIN pendingMessages)
AG_DTerm == [i \in Server |-> durableState[i].currentTerm]
AG_DVote == [i \in Server |-> durableState[i].votedFor]
AG_Config == [jointConfig |-> <<InitServer, {}>>, learners |-> {}]
AG_MessageType(M) ==
  \A m \in M : /\ m.msource \in Server
                /\ m.mdest \in Server
                /\ m.mterm \in Nat
AG_Bound(E, ts, vs) ==
  \A e \in E : /\ e[2] <= ts[e[1]]
               /\ (e[2] = ts[e[1]] => vs[e[1]] = e[3])
AG_Consistent(E) ==
  \A e, f \in E : e[1] = f[1] /\ e[2] = f[2] => e[3] = f[3]
AG_Types ==
  /\ currentTerm \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ state \in [Server -> {Follower, Candidate, Leader}]
  /\ votedFor \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}]
  /\ votesGranted \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ durableState = [i \in Server |-> durableState[i]]
  /\ AG_DTerm \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ AG_DVote \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}]
  /\ config = [i \in Server |-> AG_Config]
  /\ \A i \in Server : durableState[i].config = AG_Config
  /\ IsABag(messages) /\ IsABag(pendingMessages)
  /\ AG_MessageType(DOMAIN messages)
  /\ AG_MessageType(DOMAIN pendingMessages)
AG_Persistence ==
  \A i \in Server :
    /\ AG_DTerm[i] <= currentTerm[i]
    /\ (AG_DTerm[i] = currentTerm[i] /\ AG_DVote[i] # Nil
        => votedFor[i] = AG_DVote[i])
AG_SelfVote == \A i \in AG_Active : votedFor[i] = i
AG_LeaderQuorums ==
  \A i \in Server : state[i] = Leader =>
    \E Q \in Quorum(InitServer) : Q \subseteq votesGranted[i]
AG_ElectionInv ==
  /\ AG_Types
  /\ AG_Persistence
  /\ AG_SelfVote
  /\ AG_LeaderQuorums
  /\ AG_Bound(AG_All, currentTerm, votedFor)
  /\ AG_Bound(AG_Stable, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote)
  /\ AG_Consistent(AG_All)

LOCAL AG_FS == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

LEMMA AG_FiniteBridge == \A S :
  /\ IsFiniteSet(S) = AG_FS!IsFiniteSet(S)
  /\ Cardinality(S) = AG_FS!Cardinality(S)
  BY Isa DEF IsFiniteSet, AG_FS!IsFiniteSet,
                     Cardinality, AG_FS!Cardinality

LEMMA AG_QuorumIntersection ==
  \A Q, R \in Quorum(InitServer) : Q \cap R # {}
PROOF
  <1>1. ASSUME NEW Q \in Quorum(InitServer), NEW R \in Quorum(InitServer)
        PROVE Q \cap R # {}
    <2>1. IsFiniteSet(Q) /\ IsFiniteSet(R)
      BY AG_FS!FS_Subset, FiniteServers, AG_FiniteBridge, SMTT("r2") DEF Quorum
    <2>2. Cardinality(Q) \in Nat /\ Cardinality(R) \in Nat
          /\ Cardinality(InitServer) \in Nat
      BY <2>1, AG_FS!FS_CardinalityType, FiniteServers, AG_FiniteBridge, SMTT("r2")
    <2>3. Cardinality(Q) + Cardinality(R) > Cardinality(InitServer)
      BY <2>2, SMTT("r2") DEF Quorum
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>3, AG_FS!FS_MajoritiesIntersect, FiniteServers, AG_FiniteBridge, SMTT("r2") DEF Quorum
  <1> QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r2")

LEMMA AG_ElectionConsequence == AG_ElectionInv => MoreThanOneLeaderInv
PROOF
  <1>1. ASSUME AG_ElectionInv, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
               currentTerm[i] = currentTerm[j], state[i] = Leader, state[j] = Leader
        PROVE i = j
    <2>1. PICK Q \in Quorum(InitServer) : Q \subseteq votesGranted[i]
      BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_LeaderQuorums
    <2>2. PICK R \in Quorum(InitServer) : R \subseteq votesGranted[j]
      BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_LeaderQuorums
    <2>3. PICK v \in Q \cap R : TRUE
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, AG_QuorumIntersection, SMTT("r2")
    <2>4. <<v, currentTerm[i], i>> \in AG_All /\ <<v, currentTerm[j], j>> \in AG_All
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r2") DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_All, AG_Stable, AG_Counted, AG_Active
    <2> QED BY <1>1, <2>4, SMTT("r2") DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Consistent
  <1> QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF MoreThanOneLeaderInv

LEMMA AG_ElectionInit == Init => AG_ElectionInv
  BY DistinctRoles, SMTT("r5")
  DEF Init, InitMessageVars, InitServerVars, InitCandidateVars,
      InitLeaderVars, InitLogVars, InitConfigVars, InitDurableState,
      AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_Persistence, AG_SelfVote,
      AG_LeaderQuorums, AG_Bound, AG_Consistent, AG_MessageType,
      AG_Config, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_All, AG_Stable, AG_Counted,
      AG_Active, AG_MessageCerts, EmptyBag, SetToBag, IsABag


LOCAL AG_BT == INSTANCE BagsTheorems

LEMMA AG_BagBridge == \A A, C :
  /\ IsABag(A) = AG_BT!IsABag(A)
  /\ A (-) C = AG_BT!(-)(A,C)
  BY Isa DEF IsABag, AG_BT!IsABag, (-), AG_BT!(-)

LEMMA AG_BagDifferenceFacts ==
  ASSUME NEW A, NEW C, IsABag(A), IsABag(C)
  PROVE /\ IsABag(A (-) C)
        /\ DOMAIN (A (-) C) =
           {e \in DOMAIN A : e \notin DOMAIN C \/ A[e] > C[e]}
  BY AG_BagBridge, AG_BT!Bags_Difference, SMTT("r2")

LEMMA AG_BagAdd ==
  ASSUME NEW B, NEW m, IsABag(B)
  PROVE /\ IsABag(WithMessage(m, B))
        /\ DOMAIN WithMessage(m, B) = (DOMAIN B) \cup {m}
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF WithMessage, SetToBag, (+), IsABag

LEMMA AG_BagRemove ==
  ASSUME NEW B, NEW m, IsABag(B)
  PROVE /\ IsABag(WithoutMessage(m, B))
        /\ DOMAIN WithoutMessage(m, B) \subseteq DOMAIN B
  BY AG_BagDifferenceFacts, SMTT("r3") DEF WithoutMessage, SetToBag, IsABag

LEMMA AG_BagClear ==
  ASSUME NEW i, IsABag(pendingMessages)
  PROVE /\ IsABag(ClearPendingMessages(i))
        /\ DOMAIN ClearPendingMessages(i) =
            {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
  BY AG_BagDifferenceFacts, SMTT("r3") DEF ClearPendingMessages, PendingMessages, IsABag

LEMMA AG_BagSend ==
  ASSUME NEW i, IsABag(messages), IsABag(pendingMessages), SendPendingMessages(i)
  PROVE /\ IsABag(messages') /\ IsABag(pendingMessages')
        /\ DOMAIN messages' = DOMAIN messages \cup
                {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource = i}
        /\ DOMAIN pendingMessages' =
                {m \in DOMAIN pendingMessages : m.msource # i}
  BY AG_BagDifferenceFacts, SMTT("r3") DEF SendPendingMessages, PendingMessages, (+), IsABag

LEMMA AG_CertificateTypes == AG_Types => AG_All \subseteq (Server \X Nat \X Server)
  BY SMTT("r3") DEF AG_Types, AG_All, AG_Stable, AG_Counted, AG_Active,
                       AG_MessageCerts, AG_MessageType

LEMMA AG_Shrink ==
  ASSUME AG_ElectionInv,
         UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votedFor, votesGranted, config, durableState>>,
         IsABag(messages'), IsABag(pendingMessages'),
         DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages,
         DOMAIN pendingMessages' \subseteq DOMAIN pendingMessages
  PROVE AG_ElectionInv'
PROOF
  <1>1. AG_All' \subseteq AG_All /\ AG_Stable' \subseteq AG_Stable
    BY SMTT("r3") DEF AG_All, AG_Stable, AG_Counted, AG_Active, AG_MessageCerts
  <1>2. AG_Types' /\ AG_Persistence' /\ AG_SelfVote' /\ AG_LeaderQuorums'
    BY SMTT("r3") DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_MessageType,
       AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_Persistence, AG_SelfVote, AG_Active, AG_LeaderQuorums
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r3")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Bound, AG_Consistent, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote

  <1>2. AG_Types'
    BY DistinctRoles, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_MessageType, Timeout, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
  <1>3. AG_Persistence'
    BY DistinctRoles, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_MessageType, AG_Persistence, Timeout, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
  <1>4. AG_SelfVote'
    BY DistinctRoles, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_MessageType, AG_SelfVote, AG_Active, Timeout, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
  <1>5. AG_LeaderQuorums'
    BY DistinctRoles, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_MessageType, AG_LeaderQuorums, Timeout, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
  <1>6. AG_Bound(AG_All, currentTerm, votedFor)
          /\ AG_Bound(AG_Stable, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote)
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF AG_ElectionInv
  <1>7. AG_Bound(AG_All', currentTerm', votedFor')
    BY <1>1, <1>6, AG_CertificateTypes, DistinctRoles, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_MessageType, AG_Bound, AG_Persistence, Timeout, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
  <1>8. AG_Bound(AG_Stable', AG_DTerm', AG_DVote')
    BY <1>1, <1>6, DistinctRoles, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote, AG_MessageType, AG_Bound, Timeout, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars, logVars, configVars
  <1>9. AG_Consistent(AG_All')
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Consistent
  <1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9, SMTT("r1") DEF AG_ElectionInv

LEMMA AG_VoteResponse ==
  ASSUME AG_ElectionInv, NEW m \in DOMAIN messages, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, i = m.mdest, j = m.msource, m.mtype = RequestVoteResponse,
         HandleRequestVoteResponse(i,j,m)
  PROVE AG_ElectionInv'

\* A newly generated positive response records the current vote.  All
\* other message generation is a special case with no new certificate.
LEMMA AG_SendCertificate ==
  ASSUME AG_ElectionInv, NEW n,
    UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, state, votesGranted, config, durableState>>,
    votedFor' \in [Server -> Server \cup {Nil}],
    \A i \in Server : votedFor[i] # Nil => votedFor'[i] = votedFor[i],
    IsABag(messages'), DOMAIN messages' \subseteq DOMAIN messages,
    pendingMessages' = WithMessage(n, pendingMessages),
    AG_MessageType({n}),
    n.mtype = RequestVoteResponse /\ n.mvoteGranted =>
      /\ n.mterm = currentTerm[n.msource]
      /\ votedFor'[n.msource] = n.mdest
  PROVE AG_ElectionInv'
PROOF
  <1>1. AG_All' \subseteq AG_All \cup AG_MessageCerts({n})
        /\ AG_Stable' \subseteq AG_Stable
    BY AG_BagAdd, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_All, AG_Stable, AG_Counted,
        AG_Active, AG_MessageCerts
  <1>2. AG_Types'
    BY AG_BagAdd, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Types, AG_MessageType, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote
  <1>3. AG_Persistence' /\ AG_SelfVote' /\ AG_LeaderQuorums'
    BY NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_ElectionInv, AG_Persistence, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote,
        AG_SelfVote, AG_Active, AG_LeaderQuorums
  <1>4. AG_All \subseteq (Server \X Nat \X Server)
    BY AG_CertificateTypes, SMTT("r1") DEF AG_ElectionInv
  <1>5. AG_Bound(AG_All, currentTerm, votedFor)
        /\ AG_Bound(AG_Stable, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote)
        /\ AG_Consistent(AG_All)
    BY SMTT("r1") DEF AG_ElectionInv
  <1>6. AG_Bound(AG_All', currentTerm', votedFor')
    BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_Bound, AG_MessageCerts, AG_MessageType
  <1>7. AG_Bound(AG_Stable', AG_DTerm', AG_DVote')
    BY <1>1, <1>5, SMTT("r2") DEF AG_Bound, AG_DTerm, AG_DVote
  <1>8. AG_Consistent(AG_All')
    BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, NilNotServer, SMTT("r5")
    DEF AG_Consistent, AG_Bound, AG_MessageCerts, AG_MessageType
  <1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, SMTT("r1") DEF AG_ElectionInv
